title: Estilo indirecto: say, tell, ask (introducción)
short: Contar lo que dijo otra persona: «I'm tired» → She said she ==was== tired. He ==told me== that… She ==asked me if==…

story.title: Contar lo que te dijeron
story.text: Cuando cuentas lo que dijo alguien, igual que en español, el verbo suele ==ir un paso atrás== en el pasado.

story.title: Say algo, tell a alguien
story.text: ==say== va sin persona: He said that… ==tell== necesita a la persona: He told ==me== that… Nunca «said me» ni «told that».

examples.t: My son said he was coming.
My son told me he was coming.
examples.es: Mi hijo me dijo que venía.

story.title: Un paso atrás
story.text: Así cambia el verbo cuando lo cuentas. ==That== es opcional.

story.title: Cambian también las personas
story.text: Igual que en español, los pronombres y posesivos se adaptan a ==quién habla ahora==.

examples.t: She said she loved my paella.
examples.es: Dijo que le encantaba mi paella.

story.title: Preguntas y peticiones
story.text: Preguntas: ==asked if== (sí/no) o ==asked where/what…== con orden normal. Órdenes y consejos: ==told me to== / ==asked me to== + verbo.

examples.t: She asked me if I was OK.
He asked me where I lived.
The doctor told me to rest.
examples.es: El médico me dijo que descansara.

story.title: ¡Como en español!
story.text: «Dice: estoy cansada» → «Dijo que ==estaba== cansada». El paso atrás es igual. La diferencia: «me dijo» es ==told me==, no «said me», y «que» puede desaparecer.

examples.t: She told me she was pregnant.

story.title: Errores típicos
story.text:
❌ He said me that… ✅ He ==told== me that…
❌ She told that… ✅ She ==said== that…
❌ He asked me where did I live. ✅ He asked me where ==I lived==.

story.title: Si sigue siendo verdad
story.text: Si lo que dijo ==sigue siendo verdad== ahora, en la conversación puedes no cambiar el verbo: She said she ==loves== London.

compare.es: En español, al contar lo que dijo alguien, también retrocedemos el tiempo: «Estoy cansada» → «Dijo que estaba cansada»; «Iré» → «Dijo que iría». «Que» es obligatorio y «decir» vale con o sin persona («dijo», «me dijo»).
compare.target: En inglés el paso atrás es casi igual (am → was, will → would, can → could, have → had). Pero say va sin persona (She said that…) y tell siempre con persona (She told me that…). That se puede quitar. Las preguntas indirectas llevan orden normal (He asked where I lived) y las órdenes, told/asked + persona + to: The doctor told me to rest.

errors.wrong: He said me that he was ill.
errors.right: He told me that he was ill.
errors.why: Con persona (me), el verbo es tell: told me.

errors.wrong: She told that she was coming.
errors.right: She said that she was coming.
errors.why: Tell necesita persona; sin ella, say.

errors.wrong: He asked me where did I live.
errors.right: He asked me where I lived.
errors.why: En la pregunta indirecta no hay did: orden normal.

errors.wrong: The doctor told me rest more.
errors.right: The doctor told me to rest more.
errors.why: Told me + to + verbo para órdenes y consejos.

errors.wrong: She asked me that I was hungry.
errors.right: She asked me if I was hungry.
errors.why: Para preguntas de sí o no: asked if.

exercises.q: She ___ me that she was pregnant.
exercises.why: Con persona (me): told me.

exercises.q: He ___ that the train was late.
exercises.why: Sin persona detrás: said.

exercises.q: My friend said she ___ tired.
exercises.why: I'm tired → she was tired.

exercises.q: "I'll call you tomorrow." → He said he ___ call me the next day.
exercises.why: Will da un paso atrás: would.

exercises.q: "I can't come." → She said she ___ come.
exercises.why: Can't da un paso atrás: couldn't.

exercises.q: The doctor told me ___ more water.
exercises.why: Consejos y órdenes: told me + to + verbo.

exercises.q: She asked me ___ I was OK.
exercises.why: Pregunta de sí o no: asked if.

exercises.q: He asked me where I ___.
exercises.why: En la pregunta indirecta, orden normal y sin did: where I lived.

exercises.q: My son ___ me to call him when I arrived.
exercises.why: Pedir algo a alguien: asked me to…

exercises.q: My neighbour ___ me that she was moving.
exercises.es: Mi vecina me dijo que se mudaba.
answer: told
exercises.why: Con persona (me): told.

exercises.q: My son ___ he was coming for dinner.
exercises.es: Mi hijo dijo que venía a cenar.
answer: said
exercises.why: Sin persona detrás: said.

exercises.q: "I love your paella." → She said she loved ___ paella.
exercises.es: Dijo que le encantaba mi paella.
answer: my
exercises.why: Your (de quien hablaba) → my (ahora hablo yo).

exercises.q: "I'm very happy." → He said he ___ very happy.
answer: was
exercises.why: Am → was.

exercises.q: "We live in Leeds." → They said they ___ in Leeds.
answer: lived
exercises.why: Presente simple → pasado simple: lived.

exercises.q: "I'll help you." → She said she ___ help me.
answer: would
'd
exercises.why: Will → would.

exercises.q: The nurse asked me ___ I had any allergies.
exercises.es: La enfermera me preguntó si tenía alguna alergia.
answer: if
whether
exercises.why: Pregunta de sí o no: asked if (o whether).

exercises.q: "I can drive." → He said he ___ drive.
answer: could
exercises.why: Can → could.

exercises.q: "I have finished." → She said she ___ finished.
answer: had
'd
exercises.why: Have finished → had finished.

exercises.q: "I'm tired."
answer: She said she was tired.
She said that she was tired.
exercises.why: I'm → she was.

exercises.instr: Cuéntalo empezando por He told me…
exercises.q: "I don't like fish."
answer: He told me he didn't like fish.
He told me that he didn't like fish.
He told me he did not like fish.
He told me that he did not like fish.
exercises.why: Don't → didn't.

exercises.instr: Cuéntalo empezando por She asked me…
exercises.q: "Are you happy?"
answer: She asked me if I was happy.
She asked me whether I was happy.
exercises.why: Pregunta de sí o no: asked me if + orden normal.

exercises.instr: Cuéntalo empezando por He asked me…
exercises.q: "Where do you live?"
answer: He asked me where I lived.
exercises.why: Sin do: where I lived.

exercises.instr: Cuéntalo empezando por The doctor told me…
exercises.q: "Rest for a few days."
answer: The doctor told me to rest for a few days.
exercises.why: Orden o consejo: told me to + verbo.

exercises.q: He said me that he was ill.
exercises.why: Con persona (me), told.

exercises.q: She told that she was coming.
exercises.why: Sin persona, said.

exercises.q: He said he will call me, but he didn't.
exercises.why: Al contarlo en pasado: will → would.

exercises.q: She asked me that I was hungry.
exercises.why: Pregunta de sí o no: asked if.

exercises.answer: She told me she was pregnant
exercises.why: Me dijo = told me.

exercises.es: Mi hijo dijo que vendría el domingo
exercises.answer: My son said he would come on Sunday
exercises.why: Will → would; sin persona, said.

exercises.q: Mi amiga me dijo que estaba muy contenta.
answer: My friend told me she was very happy.
My friend told me that she was very happy.
My friend said she was very happy.
My friend said that she was very happy.
exercises.why: Me dijo = told me; estaba = was.

exercises.q: Me preguntó si tenía hambre.
answer: She asked me if I was hungry.
He asked me if I was hungry.
She asked me whether I was hungry.
He asked me whether I was hungry.
She asked if I was hungry.
He asked if I was hungry.
exercises.why: Preguntar si… = ask if; tener hambre = be hungry.

exercises.q: He told me not to worry.
answer: Me dijo que no me preocupara.
Me dijo que no me preocupase.
Me dijo que no me preocupe.
Me dijo que no me preocupara de nada.
exercises.why: Told me not to… = me dijo que no…

exercises.context: Tu hijo te dijo por teléfono «I'm coming home for Christmas». Se lo cuentas a una amiga.
options: He said he was coming home for Christmas.
He said me he was coming home for Christmas.
He told that he was coming home for Christmas.
exercises.answer: He said he was coming home for Christmas.
exercises.why: Said sin persona; I'm coming → he was coming.
Verbos para contar lo que dijo alguien.

exercises.q: "Don't worry." → She told me ___ worry.
exercises.why: Orden negativa: told me not to + verbo.
